objective: Run one fresh, exactly-once SUBJECT_GENERALIZATION_V1 quality replicate that keeps the v9 six-subject cohort and sampled data fixed (selection seed 43) while changing only the model seed to 44.
deliverables: A reviewed v10 protocol whose six subjects, folds, cap, and stage settings equal v9 while model_seed equals 44.
Fresh exactly-once dispatch evidence, resource admission, source snapshot binding, and terminal validation for v10.
Locked-TF2.4 standalone verification for the parent runtime and every v10 child.
A seed-43/seed-44 fixed-cohort comparison that reports per-fold and aggregate test metrics without comparing to the manuscript's random-split accuracy.
nonGoals: Do not retry, resume, relaunch, or reuse any prior run namespace.
Do not change the six selected subjects, fold pairing, cache receipt, cap, epochs, or stage specifications between v9 and v10.
Do not claim paper-exact replication or compare subject-held-out results to the manuscript's 83% random-split value.
acceptance: Plan-only protocol proves selection_seed=43, model_seed=44, identical pilot subjects and test/validation pairs to v9, cap=64, and 12 epochs per stage.
Focused plan16 quality tests pass before dispatch.
Fresh resource, launch-binding, independent-review, and canonical-gate evidence pass before the one production invocation.
Parent terminal-validation and standalone locked-TF2.4 verification pass for all six child runs.
The comparison explicitly treats v9/v10 as the first same-cohort two-seed evidence, not a final multi-seed conclusion.

ownership: protocol, gating artifacts, dispatch decision, verification, and final comparison
doneWhen: All acceptance evidence is present or a failure is recorded without retrying v10.

decisions: Standing authorization allows a fresh in-scope v10 but does not waive exactly-once gates.
selection_seed remains 43 so cohort selection and capped sampled members remain comparable to v9.
model_seed changes from 43 to 44 to measure initialization/training variability.
No production launch occurs before a new versioned review and canonical gate pass.
